# Local package snapshot

`pi-durable-expo-env-0.1.0.tgz` is built from the sibling `pi-durable-expo-env` project at commit `7095a4a`. The package's MIT LICENSE and source metadata are inside the archive. The package has no Git remote yet; no repository URL is assumed.
